description: Configure the 'Insulated Water Bottle' (SKU: BOTTLE-001) to accept a custom text input for laser engraving. Navigate to Catalog > Products, edit the product, and add a Customizable Option with the following settings: Option Title 'Laser Engraving', Option Type 'Text Field', Required 'No', Price '4.99' Fixed, SKU 'engrave', and Max Characters '15'. Save the product. If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.
